identity: A W/B token-aggro deck that wins in the air. Nine of its twenty-three nonland copies (six distinct cards) make creature tokens, and it converts that width into damage with seven payoff copies: two Intangible Virtue, two Rally the Peasants, Crusader of Odric, Odric Lunarch Marshal, and Wedding Announcement's Wedding Festivity side. Lingering Souls at two copies supplies eight of the deck's eleven flying Spirit bodies across four casts, and Odric then reads those Spirits and grants the ENTIRE board flying every combat, so the ground half of the swarm attacks over blockers too. Black supplies five removal spells, Village Rites to turn a dying token into two cards, and Siege Zombie as a damage source that needs no combat at all.

sideboard.name: Sever the Bloodline
sideboard.oracle_text:
Exile target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature.
Flashback {5}{B}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
sideboard.when_to_board: vs token/go-wide and recursion decks: 'Exile target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature' removes a whole token type at once, and exile beats undying and graveyard recursion.

sideboard.name: Angelic Purge
sideboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a permanent.
Exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs the cube's 24 artifacts and 25 enchantments: 'Exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment'; a spare token pays the sacrifice cost, which this deck's 13 token-making copies always supply.

sideboard.name: Slayer of the Wicked
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may destroy target Vampire, Werewolf, or Zombie.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs the cube's three largest non-Human tribes (Vampire 23, Zombie 15, Werewolf 13 = 51 cards): a 3/2 body plus 'you may destroy target Vampire, Werewolf, or Zombie'.

sideboard.name: Valorous Stance
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature gains indestructible until end of turn. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
sideboard.when_to_board: primarily on its second mode - 'Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater' answers the large ground wall a token board cannot fight through. The indestructible mode also saves Odric or an anthem carrier from targeted removal; the cube has only 4 sweepers, so that is the minor use.

sideboard.name: Collective Brutality
sideboard.oracle_text:
Escalate—Discard a card. (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card.
• Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
• Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs control and combo, where W/B fields no counterspell: 'Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card' is this colour pair's only proactive answer to a spell before it is cast.

Nueve de sus veintitrés copias no-tierra (seis cartas distintas) crean fichas de criatura, y convierte esa anchura en daño con siete copias de recompensa: dos Intangible Virtue, dos Rally the Peasants, Crusader of Odric, Odric Lunarch Marshal, y la cara Wedding Festivity de Wedding Announcement. Lingering Souls a dos copias aporta ocho de los once cuerpos de Espíritu volador del mazo repartidos en cuatro lanzamientos, y Odric lee entonces esos Espíritus y otorga volar a TODO el tablero en cada combate, así que la mitad terrestre del enjambre también ataca por encima de los bloqueadores. El negro aporta cinco hechizos de eliminación, Village Rites para convertir una ficha moribunda en dos cartas, y Siege Zombie como fuente de daño que no necesita combate alguno.
